---
title: "Microbial community analyses: alpha and beta diversity"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
params:
  data_dir: "downstream_input"   # folder with the count tables and metadata files
  out_dir: "results/downstream"    # where figures and tables are written
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6)
dir.create(params$out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# The permutation tests (randtest) use random numbers. The seed is fixed so that the p-values can be reproduced.
seed <- 1234

# Finds an input table: directly in params$data_dir, otherwise anywhere below it (the name must be unique there).
find_input <- function(name) {
  direct <- file.path(params$data_dir, name)
  if (file.exists(direct)) return(direct)
  found <- list.files(params$data_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  hits <- found[basename(found) == name]
  if (length(hits) == 1) return(hits)
  stop(if (length(hits) == 0) "Input file not found: " else "Input file name is not unique: ", name,
       " (searched in '", params$data_dir, "')", call. = FALSE)
}
```

# Microbial community analyses

## Alpha diversity analysis

```{r alpha-diversity}
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)

count <- read.csv(find_input("countdata.csv"), header = T, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
meta <- read.csv(find_input("metadata.csv"), header = T, row.names = 1)

ps <- phyloseq(otu_table(count, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
               sample_data(meta))
ps

p <- plot_richness(ps, "Origin", color = "Origin", measures = c("Shannon", "Simpson"))

p + geom_boxplot(aes(x = Origin, colour = Origin)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black"),
    # Facet strip formatting
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    # Axis text for the numeric axis (bottom after flip)
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    # Legend
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  # Use element_markdown for the axis that now shows plant names (y-axis after flip)
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18))
```

## Beta diversity analysis

### Rhizosphere-wise

```{r beta-rhizosphere-data}
library(ade4)
library("factoextra")
library(dplyr)

c <- read.csv(find_input("countdata_plant.csv"), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
meta <- read.csv(find_input("metadata_plant.csv"))

# the columns of the count table must be in the same order as the samples of the metadata
stopifnot(identical(colnames(c), meta$Sample))

library(microbiome)
transform <- microbiome::transform

rel <- transform(c, "compositional")
rel2 <- as.matrix(t(rel))

my_colors <- c(
  "red", "blue", "darkgreen", "purple")

res.pca <- dudi.pca(rel2,
                    scannf = FALSE, nf = 5)

groups <- as.factor(meta$Plant)

s.class(res.pca$li,
        fac = groups,   # color by groups
        col = my_colors, clabel = 0)
```

```{r beta-rhizosphere-pca}
group_colors <- my_colors

fviz_pca_ind(res.pca,
             col.ind = groups,
             palette = group_colors,
             addEllipses = FALSE,
             mean.point = FALSE,
             repel = TRUE,
             label = "none",
             pointsize = 2,
             pointshape = 19,
             alpha.ind = 0.7) +
  labs(color = "Plants") +   # <-- new legend title
  theme_bw() + theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, family = "Arial"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, family = "Arial"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, family = "Arial"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, family = "Arial"),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, family = "Arial"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, family = "Arial"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, family = "Arial", face = "italic"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.5, color = "gray40")
  )
```

```{r beta-rhizosphere-test}
set.seed(seed)
rand1 <- randtest(bca(res.pca, groups, scan = FALSE), 999)
rand1
```

### Soil-wise

```{r beta-soil-data}
library(ade4)
library("factoextra")
library(dplyr)

c <- read.csv(find_input("countdata_soil.csv"), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
meta <- read.csv(find_input("metadata_soil.csv"))

# the columns of the count table must be in the same order as the samples of the metadata
stopifnot(identical(colnames(c), meta$Sample))

library(microbiome)
transform <- microbiome::transform

rel <- transform(c, "compositional")
rel2 <- as.matrix(t(rel))

my_colors <- c(
  "red", "blue", "darkgreen", "orange", "purple",
  "brown", "pink", "cyan", "magenta", "gold",
  "limegreen", "tomato")

res.pca <- dudi.pca(rel2,
                    scannf = FALSE, nf = 5)

groups <- as.factor(meta$Region)

s.class(res.pca$li,
        fac = groups,   # color by groups
        col = my_colors, clabel = 0)
```

```{r beta-soil-pca}
group_colors <- my_colors

fviz_pca_ind(res.pca,
             col.ind = groups,
             palette = group_colors,
             addEllipses = FALSE,
             mean.point = FALSE,
             repel = TRUE,
             label = "none",
             pointsize = 2,
             pointshape = 19,
             alpha.ind = 0.7) +
  labs(color = "Sampling location") +   # <-- new legend title
  theme_bw() + theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, family = "Arial"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, family = "Arial"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, family = "Arial"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, family = "Arial"),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, family = "Arial"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, family = "Arial"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, family = "Arial"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.5, color = "gray40")
  )
```

```{r beta-soil-test}
set.seed(seed)
rand1 <- randtest(bca(res.pca, groups, scan = FALSE), 999)
rand1
```
